package.description: Convert files between hundreds of formats and keep them in a company drive.

en-US.author: PROJECTTEAMFORYOU
en-US.description: Convert files between hundreds of formats and keep them in a company drive.
en-US.longDescription:
OmniDesk converts documents, images, audio, video, e-books, archives, CAD
drawings, fonts and data between hundreds of file formats, and keeps the
results in a drive that is isolated per company.

Pairs with no direct converter are chained through intermediate formats
automatically, so a conversion works even when no single engine covers it.

The window is a thin shell: conversion runs on the server, so the app does
not need reinstalling when formats are added. The same account works in a
browser at https://app.omnidesk.win. The interface is available in
12 languages.
en-US.name: OmniDesk
